The December 18 clash: “Dunesday”

Two of the biggest franchises on Earth open on the same day — Friday, 18 December 2026. Robert Downey Jr. and Timothée Chalamet have already joked about the head-to-head in public. Pick a side, or do the double feature.

Marvel Studios · Cinemas

Avengers: Doomsday

Robert Downey Jr. returns to the MCU — this time as Doctor Doom. Directed by the Russo brothers, with Chris Hemsworth, Pedro Pascal, Florence Pugh and Vanessa Kirby. Reportedly ~165 minutes.

Dune: Part Three

Denis Villeneuve closes his trilogy, adapting Dune Messiah. Timothée Chalamet and Zendaya return, with Florence Pugh, Anya Taylor-Joy and Robert Pattinson joining as Scytale. Music by Hans Zimmer.

How to watch legally (and skip the fake sites)

  1. Find the title aboveEvery card names the confirmed home: a cinema release date, or the exact streaming platform and premiere date.
  2. Watch the trailer on the official channelStudios post trailers first on their own YouTube channels — Marvel, Warner Bros., Disney, Universal, Sony, Paramount, Lionsgate. Search the film title + “official trailer” and pick the studio's verified channel; fan-made “trailers” are a common scam lure.
  3. Book or stream through official appsCinemas: your local chain's app or official ticketing partners. Streaming: subscribe or rent inside Netflix, HBO Max, Prime Video, Disney+, Apple TV, Peacock or JioHotstar — never an “APK download” site.
  4. After the cinema runMost theatrical films reach a streaming platform or digital rental 45–90 days later. When a streaming date is confirmed for a cinema title, it appears on its card here.
Why no download links? “Free movie download” and mod-APK sites are the top source of malware and legal notices for viewers, and they get shut down constantly. Everything on this page points to the licensed release instead — same film, no risk.

Movie questions, answered

What is the biggest movie releasing in December 2026?

December 18, 2026 is the year's biggest day: Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three open head-to-head — the clash fans call “Dunesday”. Shah Rukh Khan's King follows on December 24 and Jumanji 3 on December 25, making it the most crowded Christmas corridor in years.

When does Ramayana: Part 1 release, and who stars in it?

Worldwide in cinemas on 5 November 2026 (Diwali window). Ranbir Kapoor plays Rama, Sai Pallavi is Sita, Yash plays Ravana and Sunny Deol is Hanuman, with Ravi Dubey as Lakshmana. Nitesh Tiwari directs; Hans Zimmer and A. R. Rahman compose. Advance bookings opened to a reported ₹1.53 crore for opening day in early tracking.

When is Shah Rukh Khan's King releasing?

24 December 2026, Christmas Eve. Directed by Siddharth Anand (Pathaan), it stars Shah Rukh Khan alongside Suhana Khan in her big-screen debut, Deepika Padukone and Abhishek Bachchan, on a reported ₹350 crore budget.

What's the #1 movie on streaming right now (October 2026)?

On Netflix US, Ben Affleck's thriller Animals tops the movie chart. On HBO Max, Evil Dead Burn is #1 worldwide while Sydney Sweeney's The Housemaid is the most-watched film in the US. Charts change weekly — the Streaming section above reflects the latest snapshot, dated 21 October 2026.

When will Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three stream online?

No streaming date has been announced for either film yet — both are cinema-first releases opening 18 December 2026. Based on recent Marvel and Warner Bros. patterns, expect official streaming or digital rental roughly 2–3 months after the theatrical opening, announced by the studios closer to the time. Anything offering them earlier is not legal.

Which family films are coming for the holidays?

The Cat in the Hat (6 Nov), Disney's Hexed (25 Nov) and Jumanji 3 (25 Dec) headline the family slate, with Ice Age: Boiling Point following on 5 February 2027.

Do release dates change?

Yes — studios move dates regularly. Jumanji 3, for example, shifted from 11 December to Christmas Day 2026 specifically to avoid the Doomsday/Dune clash. This guide is a dated snapshot (21 Oct 2026); always confirm on the studio or cinema listing before booking.

Is this site affiliated with any studio or platform?

No. It's an independent guide. Titles, dates and platforms are compiled from studio announcements and reputable entertainment reporting (sources listed below), and all viewing is done on the official services themselves.
